definitions.explanation: A rich, deep shade of green. Used to describe the color of dense foliage, fabric, paint, and other objects with an intense green hue.

examples.japanese: {濃緑|のうりょく}の{森|もり}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: A deep green forest stretched out before us.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると{葉|は}が{濃緑|のうりょく}{色|しょく}に{変|か}わる。
examples.english: In summer, the leaves turn a deep green color.

examples.japanese: {濃緑|のうりょく}の{制服|せいふく}を{着|き}た{生徒|せいと}たちが{校門|こうもん}をくぐっていった。
examples.english: Students wearing dark green uniforms walked through the school gate.

notes:
Composed of {濃|のう} (dense/thick/dark) + {緑|りょく} (green). The on'yomi reading のうりょく is a homophone of {能力|のうりょく} (ability), so context is needed to distinguish them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃緑|のうりょく}{色|しょく}: dark green color
- {濃緑|のうりょく}の{葉|は}: dark green leaves
- {濃緑|のうりょく}の{森|もり}: deep green forest

RELATED COLOR WORDS:
- {深緑|しんりょく}/{深緑|ふかみどり}: deep green — near-synonym; {深緑|ふかみどり} is the native reading
- {新緑|しんりょく}: fresh green (of new leaves in spring) — bright and light, the opposite mood
- {淡緑|たんりょく}: light green; pale green — the opposite intensity
- {黄緑|きみどり}: yellow-green — lighter and warmer
